notes.title: Frog Fighters 0.6.1 Hotfix
notes.content:
Hey everyone, hope you all are having a lovely day.

This update addresses an issue where players would get a force applied to them when a nearby player died. This issue has been fixed.

If you have any other bugs, be sure to report them through Steam or Discord!

notes.title: NEW MAP! - Frog Fighters Update 0.6
notes.content:
[h1]Happy New Year Everyone! I hope your resolutions come to fruition and may 2022 be better than than the past few years.[/h1]

[h2]Regardless, update 0.6 brings a new map and a way for hosts to get rid of misbehaving players, along with some other small changes.[/h2]

[h2]New Map: Island:[/h2]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40280210/84c5c4ced2d68e2b6931c2147b9b3193daacdaaa.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40280210/53ac59f90622f8cb8075aecfdbe1b433fe771921.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Kick Clients:[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/EgFl7B7.png[/img]

[h3]Full List Of Changes:[/h3]

notes.title: Frog Fighters Update 0.4
notes.content:
[h1]Frog Fighters has been updated to version 0.4![/h1]

[h2]This update brings a new game mode, upgrades, and more![/h2]

[h3]Full List Of Changes:[/h3]

[list]
[*]Added countdown timer.
[*]Bots now play death animation before respawning.
[*]New Gamemode: Last Man Standing. Be the last one alive in an intense, fast-paced battle royale.
[*]Charged Blast will now adjust its trajectory mid-air towards its target.
[*]Last selected map and mode will now be saved, even upon restart.
[*]Stats will now be stored through Steam. Local stats will be uploaded.
[*]Added intro.
[*]Added controller support - still WIP but playable.
[*]Added new spectator camera option: cinematic camera. Toggle by pressing C while in spectator free cam.
[/list]

notes.title: Frog Fighters Update Version 0.3
notes.content:
[h1]Frog Fighters has been updated to version 0.3![/h1]

[h2]This update brings stats, achievements, new abilities, and optimizations.[/h2]

[h3]Full List Of Changes:[/h3]

[list]
[*]Added Healing Beam Secondary
[*]Added Health Regeneration Passive
[*]Added Stats Page
[*]Started Tracking Kills, Deaths, Wins, Ties, and Losses locally
[*]Adjusted playable bounds in Crash Site
[*]Added 4 new achievements: Novice Frog, Amateur Frog, Professional Frog, and Legendary Frog
[*]Map & Script Optimizations.
[/list]

notes.title: Frog Fighters Update v0.2
notes.content:
[h1][b]Frog Fighters has been updated to version 0.2![/b][/h1]

[h2]This update is mostly bug fixes, patches, and QOL improvements.[/h2] 

[h3]Full list of changes:[/h3]

[list]
[*]Add options menu in-game
[*]Fix lobbies getting destroyed on Client DC
[*]Mouse input should now feel more consistent and smooth
[*]Got rid of chat box scroll bar - you can still click and drag, and scroll
[*]Input will now be disabled while typing in the chat box
[*]Input will now be disabled while the game is paused
[*]Changed play panel to add a quick play option - will create and start a game with the same settings that were previously used
[*]Enemy solo players in scoreboard will now have a red color instead of white
[*]Reduced size of killfeed
[*]Respawn UI and Pause UI should no longer be able to overlap
[*]Respawn UI will no longer appear if spectating after death but before the panel is supposed to appear
[/list]

notes.title: FROG FIGHTERS RELEASE!
notes.content:
[b]Frog Fighters has been released as of right now! Go play it for free![/b]

[h1]How to play[/h1]
[h2]Game Modes:[/h2]
Free For All - Every frog for themselves. 5 Minutes to get the most amount of kills, or first to 30.
Team Death Match - Frogs are evenly split into teams. 5 Minutes to get the most amount of kills, or first to 100.
[h2]Controls:[/h2]
E - Speed Up
Q - Slow Down
MB1 - Fire Primary
MB2 - Fire Secondary
MB3 - Toggle Targetting
Shift - Zoom In
W/S - Pitch
A/D - Roll
Mouse - Pitch/Yaw/Roll
